body:
Recently, Child Actor 101 celebrated the growth of their community to 7,000 active Facebook Group users with a Free Online Talent Representation Open Call. This is an unprecedented opportunity to our loyal followers that puts your child actor in front of a massive amount of Talent Agents and Managers, from leaders in their fields to boutique offices to regional outfits as well. At the end of the day it takes a Momager to get those submissions together and admit that she (or he, the Dadager) needs the support.

Here is a fun homage to the Momager that is available with Free Fast Shipping and multiple colors and fits.
